questions: Should the regression line be a linear regression (default) or could it be a different type (e.g., polynomial, logistic) as allowed by seaborn's regplot?
What specific 'invalid data' triggers the TypeError? Is it only non-numeric data, or also other types like infinite values or data that cannot be cast to float?
Should the function handle missing data (NaN) silently by seaborn's default (dropping), or should it raise an error or impute?
What should be the visual style of the plot (e.g., scatter point color, size, regression line color) beyond seaborn's default?
Should the axes labels be set to the column names, or left as default (which uses column names from data)?
Is the regression line required to include a confidence interval (default in seaborn's regplot), or should it be suppressed?
Should the function add a title to the plot or any other annotations?
What should happen if the DataFrame contains exactly one row? Seaborn's regplot can plot a single point, but regression may be undefined.
